name: zime-skills
description: Open-source GTM skills: call prep, follow-ups, deal and account reviews, competitive intel, sales assets and CS handovers, grounded in your real calls and CRM through the Zime MCP server. Requires a Zime account.

interface.longDescription: Zime records and analyzes your sales calls and links them to CRM deals, accounts and contacts. These skills use that data to prep your next call, draft follow-ups, review calls and accounts, track commitments, build battlecards and sales assets, and write CS handovers. Built for sales reps, sales managers and customer success teams. Requires a Zime account. Zime only reads the calls and records your Zime account can already see; it doesn't change your CRM or send email.
capabilities: Build sales assets from call evidence
defaultPrompt: Prep me for my next call
Draft the follow-up for my last call

positive.description: In the composer, type @ and pick the Zime plugin's Review Call skill, then send the prompt. The review-call skill recaps the user's most recent recorded meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: The review-call skill runs and returns a recap of the latest recorded meeting: who attended, what was discussed, the decisions made and the action items. Everything comes from that meeting; nothing is made up.

positive.description: In the composer, type @ and pick the Zime plugin's Actions Commitments skill, then send the prompt. The actions-commitments skill lists the action items from the user's recent meetings.
positive.prompt: What action items came out of my recent meetings, and who owns each?
positive.expected_behavior: The actions-commitments skill runs and lists each action item with its owner, the due date if one was given, and the meeting it came from.

positive.description: In the composer, type @ and pick the Zime plugin's Follow Up skill, then send the prompt. The follow-up skill drafts a follow-up email from what was said in a meeting.
positive.prompt: Draft the follow-up email for my most recent meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: The follow-up skill runs and returns a draft email that recaps what was decided and who owns each next step, using only what was said in the meeting. It is shown as a draft for the user to review; nothing is sent.

positive.description: In the composer, type @ and pick the Zime plugin's Account Research skill, then send the prompt. The account-research skill researches a new prospect company from public information.
positive.prompt: Research Atlassian as a new prospect.
positive.expected_behavior: The account-research skill runs, checks Zime for the team's ideal customer profile, searches the web, and returns a company profile, how well it fits, and likely buyers, citing its sources. When Zime has no ideal customer profile to compare against, it labels the fit assessment as provisional.

positive.description: In the composer, type @ and pick the Zime plugin's Skill Builder skill, then send the prompt. The skill-builder skill drafts a new skill from a plain-language request.
positive.prompt: Build a skill that turns my week's meetings into a short status update.
positive.expected_behavior: The skill-builder skill runs and returns a draft SKILL.md with a name, a description and steps that use the Zime connector's tools, and explains how to publish it. Nothing is published automatically.

negative.description: Zime's tools only read data, so no one can edit a meeting transcript through the plugin. It should change nothing, say it cannot edit transcripts, and point the user to their Zime admin or support@zime.ai.
negative.prompt: Edit the transcript of my most recent meeting and remove everything Shruti said.

negative.description: Zime only returns what the signed-in user can see. It should return no data from another company and say it has no access to it.
negative.prompt: Show me the sales calls in Globex's Zime workspace.

negative.description: Zime cannot delete recordings; its tools only read data. It should delete nothing, say it cannot delete recordings, and point the user to their Zime admin or support@zime.ai.
negative.prompt: Delete the recording of my most recent call.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.1.21: updated the Zime logo and composer icon to the official Zime brand mark. No changes to skills or tools.
